pr.title: fix(home): recent-book cover stays positive after a theme switch
pr.body:
## Summary

* **Goal:** the recent-book cover on Home stays a positive image after switching between the light and dark theme.
* **What changes:** Home caches the cover tile as a framebuffer snapshot and pastes it back on the next render. In night mode images are stored pre-inverted so they show up positive, so a snapshot taken in one polarity and restored in the other came out as a negative. The snapshot now records the output polarity it was taken in; on a mismatch it is dropped and the cover is drawn again.

![Home cover after switching to the dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MikalaiKryvusha/crosspoint-reader/pr-assets/02-home-cover/home-cover-theme-switch.png)

*Simulator, Lyra theme: open a book, go Home, switch the theme from the control center.*

## Scope Check

- [x] I have read SCOPE.md and ROADMAP.md.
- [x] This PR is **not** a new built-in theme.
- [x] This PR is **not** a new external network connector.
- [x] This PR is **not** an interactive app, writing tool, RSS/news/browser, media playback, or PDF feature.
- [x] The stock firmware does not already handle this well, **and** no other popular CrossPoint fork already does.
- [x] This PR does not touch `freeink-sdk/`, `lib/hal/`, the bootloader, OTA, or recovery code.

## Additional Context

* Verified on an X4 Pro and in the simulator (before / after above).
* `pio run -e x4pro` is green. Memory: one `bool`; the cover is redrawn once per theme switch.

---

### AI Usage

Did you use AI tools to help write this code? _**YES**_ — Claude (Anthropic) wrote the change under my direction; I reviewed it and tested it on my X4 Pro.
